text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE TRIGGERED for inference-gateway-usw2 — sustained 5xx rate spike (14% errors over 5m, threshold 5%). PD: https://pagerduty.example/INC-19876. Pattern: 502/504 upstream resets and occasional 503. Starting escalation and paging the on-call.

jamie: ack — taking lead. jumping into metrics and logs now.

arjun: arjun here, following. were we rolling a canary to inference-gateway ~10m ago?

jamie: yes, canary started ~9m ago (rev: inf-gw@2026-03-16-09). first thing I want to check is whether the ingress proxy or kvcache is the culprit. running `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o wide`

jamie: logs snippet showing repeated upstream resets and eviction bursts:
```
2026-03-16T22:10:01Z gateway WARN upstream reset for connection id=0x7ff
evict_rate=125/s kvcache_free=18MB
2026-03-16T22:10:07Z gateway ERROR 502 upstream reset
```

arjun: that eviction rate looks suspiciously correlated with the canary. I'm going to pause the canary traffic and roll it back if errors continue.

sasha: CS heads up — we already have a couple of customers reporting increased 5xx in us-west2. I'll open a CC ticket and surface to account owners. ETA for an initial customer note? 15m?

jamie: scaling precautionarily, `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway --replicas=12` to buy room; also enabling fallback routing to model-variant-b for new requests at the edge to reduce impact.

ops-bot: Rollout pause detected for deployment inference-gateway (canary). Action: pausing new canary traffic.

luis: Can you flip routing at the API gateway to prefer fallback variant? I can push a short-lived rule.

jamie: done — `gateway-config set route /v1/* fallback=model-variant-b; weight=0.8 for canary` — new requests should prefer fallback. Observability: 5xx rate dropped from 14% -> 6.5% within 3m.

arjun: rolling back canary to stable now: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-gateway --to-revision=42` — monitoring.

pagerbot: PD INC-19876 acknowledged by jamie. Escalation paused.

jamie: rollback completed at ~22:15Z. Error rate trending down, currently ~2.8% over 2m. KV cache evictions also dropping back to baseline.

sasha: CS update: posting to affected customers that we've deployed mitigations and are monitoring; will link PD status page.

luis: recommending we run a quick load test against the canary in staging to reproduce eviction pattern before re-promoting.

arjun: agreed. creating a postmortem checklist: reproduce in staging, add eviction thresholds/alerts, adjust kvcache sizing for canary, improve rollout circuit (automated rollback on eviction spike).

jamie: I'm keeping PD open for 1h to validate stability; will hand off to night on-call at 23:00Z if all good. For now, primary mitigation actions: rollback canary, scale up replicas, enable fallback routing.

ops-bot: Note: alert suppression scheduled for 30m to avoid noise while we baseline.

jamie: thanks all. action items assigned: arjun -> reproduce in staging, luis -> add routing tests, sasha -> customer comms. I'll update the PD status and add logs/snippets to the incident.

arjun: ack. I'll also add a temporary playbook note about 'eviction-driven 502s' to the runbook.

jamie: handing off to night on-call (arjun) at 23:00Z — I'll leave a final status update 22:50Z. :thumbsup:
